title: Correct initial velocity
description: Essential Criteria: The final answer for part (1) must be v₀ = √(3qU/m).

title: Correct magnetic field
description: Essential Criteria: The final answer for part (2) must be B₀ = (2/d)√(Um/(3q)).

title: Electric field kinematics
description: Important Criteria: The solution must correctly apply kinematics (d = ½at²) to the vertical motion between the plates, relating acceleration to the electric field (a = qE/m).

title: Geometry at exit
description: Important Criteria: The solution must use the given geometry (60° baffle, distance l_KN) to determine the exit angle (30° to horizontal) or the vertical velocity component (v_y = v₀/√3).

title: Magnetic circular motion
description: Important Criteria: The solution must apply the Lorentz force as centripetal force (qvB = mv²/r) for the motion between the baffles.

title: Radius from geometry
description: Important Criteria: The solution must deduce the radius of the circular arc in the magnetic field (r = √3 d) from the condition of hitting NP vertically and the 60° geometry.

title: Velocity at point K
description: Optional Criteria: The solution may calculate the speed at the hole K (v = 2√(qU/m)) as an intermediate step.

title: Sign or direction error
description: Pitfall Criteria: Penalize if the direction of acceleration, force, or deflection is incorrect for a positive charge, or if the magnetic field direction is mishandled.

title: Kinematics mix-up
description: Pitfall Criteria: Penalize misuse of kinematic equations (e.g., using v = at instead of d = ½at² for vertical motion starting from rest).
